description: RoomPartner v9 — UI/UX redesign: warm modern light design system (indigo primary, soft neutral backgrounds, rounded-2xl cards, soft shadows), polished hero, richer listing cards, mobile bottom nav, and consistent buttons/inputs/empty states across every page. Same production hardening as v8 (security headers, rate limiting, input validation, error/404 pages, SEO + sitemap, /api/health, structured logging, timing-safe payment verification). Compatible roommates, broker-free rooms, household rentals, chat, Squad Mode, verification, rent-split. Supabase Auth, Razorpay TEST-mode checkout, Realtime chat, auto-moderation, demo escrow. Demo mode runs with seed data + localStorage; no live payments, OTP, KYC or real money.
name: room-partner-production
